body:

replies.author: San_David
replies.body:
Honestly, if Sniper is nerfed, it'll be just as worthless as Archer is. I mean, seriously, you cannot kill more than three - four people with only 32 arrows, considering that Nexus' gameplay has quite a few teamfights. Because of that, your damage tends to, but not always, get spread all over the enemy team, and not focused on one single person. When you run out of arrows, you're left with a Wood Sword, which can't do much either. The armor isn't that much either, to be honest, only one or two more points of armor, compared to full leather.

What I think should happen with the two bow classes is that Archer should get buffed with an Infinity Bow, while Sniper gets nerfed by removing a bit of chain armor and Punch, but still keeps the amount of arrows it has now.

replies.author: San_David
replies.body:
However, if they're just pulling out an arrow every quarter second, that damage is going to be reduced majorly, meaning that they're going to have to spend more arrows. Besides, you can just run around and kill them anyways, or just flat out ignore them.

And, also, something I said before, if you're talking about that other form of bow spamming, also known as "regular archery" (>.<). Because Nexus tends to have quite a few teamfights, (a 1v1 is rare for me, unless everyone's extremely isolated.) it's fairly difficult to hit a single person three times without being ks'd by the melee classes up front. The damage from your bow tends to get spread across the enemy team, not focused on one person like it needs to be for a bow class to gain kills.
